verdict.rationale: Fireworks markets that users can "Run the latest open models with a single line of code" and get "instant access to the most popular OSS models" across a catalog of 100+ models. That is a direct but thin marketing claim about recency, with no documented timing or day-zero commitment. Uploading models yourself from Hugging Face is a separate capability and is not credited as the platform supplying new releases. Missing for 10: documented day-zero or launch-timing commitments, concrete examples of time from public release to availability, a changelog or new-model announcement record, and independent or hands-on confirmation of fast onboarding.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can get newly released open-weight models on the platform quickly after their public release
